C0896.title: Reusing One Password Across Sites? Beware of Credential Stuffing Attacks Stealing Your Personal Info
C0896.summary: A case from July 2023 shows that criminals purchased citizens' email accounts and other personal information, then used Steam account checkers to perform credential stuffing, stealing Steam game accounts and passwords in bulk for illegal profit.
